title: Phase 2C pre-registered XAUUSD forward test (shadow mode, no orders)
status: registered - not started (requires a read-only shadow runner; no order placement is authorized)
data: XAUUSD M15 closed bars from MetaQuotes-Demo via the read-only MT5 connector, server tz eet_eu

candidates.rationale: Only strategy whose entries beat all 20 long-bias-matched random-entry seeds per trade (training); gross +0.03 R/trade but net -0.013 R after costs - forward test checks whether the entry information survives live costs.

controls.role: random-entry control with the candidate's exit structure

rules.costs: spread from live ticks at the simulated fill time; slippage 0.10 USD/side; commission 0 and 7 USD/lot scenarios; swap from symbol_info
rules.fills: next bar open after the signal bar close (same as replay); stop-first intrabar

checkpoints: after 100 trades or 2027-05-09, whichever is later
success_criteria_all_required: net mean R per trade > 0 under the 7 USD/lot commission scenario
bootstrap 95% CI lower bound of net mean R > -0.05
candidate per-trade net R above the median of the random-entry control seeds
positive net result in at least 2 of 3 consecutive two-month blocks
max drawdown < 6% of equity at 0.5% risk
evaluation.failure: Any criterion failing at the final checkpoint retires the candidate; no re-tuning on forward data.

not_candidates.xau-goldpilot-v1: edge over random explained by long bias in the 2022-2025 bull market; costs exceed gross edge; 3/18 configurations profitable
not_candidates.xau-orderblock-retest: 0/9 configurations profitable on training; beats only 13/20 long-matched random seeds
not_candidates.xau-liquidity-sweep-mss: 1/9 configurations profitable; shorts lose; 14/20 random seeds beaten
not_candidates.xau-orb-london: negative in every training year; 0/18 configurations profitable; significantly negative at 3,000 USD (t=-2.2)
